Locked-off camera, framing holds. The six masked men walk slowly toward the camera in step, an unhurried stride, guns resting upright on their shoulders. Their heads nod gently with each step. Long shadows slide forward over the cobbles. Every parked car stays parked and unchanged; the street stays empty behind them. Masks, gloves and suits stay exactly as they are. SFX: shoes on cobbles in a steady rhythm. Ambient noise: a quiet early-morning street.

Thanks.
